继续寻找龙鳞（继续寻找龙鳞（第22页）几人商量好，而玄机最直接的修炼方法就是到处种地，走到哪种到哪。那些乱七暴乱的灵气，邪气，魔气，都是玄稷的修炼养料，吸收的越多，她修炼的也就越快，根本没有瓶颈可言。种出来的那些稀奇古怪能吃的，他们都一起吃，也可增长修为。连带着小黑修为也蹭蹭往上涨，在半年内突破了元婴期。三年后，玄稷基本上把修士的地盘，基本全都种个遍，自身修为也早就达到了元婴期大圆满，但就是差临门一脚夸不过化神那道坎。她想到自己之前每次修为境界都是靠着龙鳞，自己又是被囚禁在这里的。玄稷知道这就是这界对自己的压制，她必须得找到龙鳞，才能真正提升自己修为。好在修为达到元婴期之后，她对龙族那些是有感应的。这天，站在群山之巅的玄稷看着剑宗的方向道：“我要去剑宗。”慕狱一听到剑宗第一个头皮发麻。他还记得上一次尊上和那剑宗的两大剑修打斗的事。尊上受了很重的伤，但那俩剑修也是出气多进气少了。要不是当时他带着尊上跑得快，估计就被人家剑宗的太上长老过来给灭了。现在小公主却要去剑中，这不是羊入虎口吗？范沐禾知道玄稷不是真正的四岁的小娃，看着她。“你是不是有非去不可的理由？”玄稷点头，“剑宗有我的东西，我要拿回来。”玄稷感应到剑宗有一片龙鳞在呼唤她，越是靠近剑宗那呼唤的声越是强烈。“好，我陪你去。”“师父也陪你。”三年来，秦征弋和范沐禾的修练也没有落下。三年来一直在吃玄稷种出来的各种天才地宝，他们的修为也是蹭蹭往上涨，已经到了半步大乘期了。而剑宗修为最高者不过一个大乘期初期，他们俩联手还是可以制衡一下对方的。已经是魔皇修为的慕狱咬牙坚定道：“老奴跟了！”只他们一行人正要下山，朝着剑宗而去的时候，前方突然凭空出现了一群人。“把那会种地的小娃留下，留尔等一条命，否则就别怪我们无情了。”为首之人是个合体期邪修，而他身后的那些人竟然还有三个半步合体期，另外三个是炼虚期。这怎么突然都了那么多大能邪修？慕狱身为团队里身份最低的，很能摆清自己的位置，第一个站出来对着对面叫嚣。“放你的猪屁！”别人骂人都是放你的狗屁，慕狱可不敢。因为他们家真有狗，还是他的大姐大呢。“看来你们是选择早死了，正好让我们哥几个好好补一补，说不定也能到大乘呢！哈哈哈……大家一块上！那个会种地的小娃可别弄伤了，留着她还有用呢！”“放肆邪修胆敢在我剑宗地界撒野！”随着声音一起而来的，是一柄巨大的剑影，朝着那几个邪修横斩而去。没错，是秦征弋跟剑宗通风报信的。他又不傻，他虽然修为有，可战力低的，这都到了剑宗地界了，没道理还要自己出手打的。

Chapter 44 Continue to look for dragon scales (page 1)
Continue to search for dragon scales (Continue to search for dragon scales (page 22)) Several people agreed, and the most direct method of cultivation for Xuanji is to farm everywhere, wherever you go. The chaotic spiritual energy, evil energy, and demonic energy are all Xuanji's cultivation nutrients. The more she absorbs, the faster she practices. There is no bottleneck at all. They eat the weird and edible things they grow together, which can also increase their cultivation. Together with this, Xiao Hei's cultivation level also increased slowly, and he broke through the Yuan Ying stage within half a year. Three years later, Xuan Ji basically cultivated all the monks' territory, and his own cultivation level had already reached the stage of Yuan Ying stage, but he just missed the threshold of becoming a god. She thought that she had relied on dragon scales every time she had cultivated before, and she was imprisoned here. Xuan Ji knew that this was the suppression of her in this world, and she had to do it. Only by finding dragon scales can she truly improve her cultivation. Fortunately, after her cultivation reached the Nascent Soul stage, she was able to sense those of the dragon clan. On this day, Xuan Ji, who was standing on the top of the mountains, looked in the direction of Jian Zong and said, "I want to go to Jian Zong." When Mu Yu heard about Jian Zong, he still remembered the last time he fought with the two sword masters of Jian Zong. If he hadn't run so fast with his Majesty, he would have been killed by the Supreme Elder of the Sword Sect. Now the little princess wants to go to the sword, isn't this a sheep entering the tiger's mouth? Fan Muhe knew that Xuan Ji was not a real four-year-old child, and looked at her. "Do you have a reason to go?" Xuan Ji nodded, "The Sword Sect has something of mine, and I want to get it back." The voice of Jian Zong became stronger. "Okay, I will accompany you." "Master will accompany you too." In the past three years, Qin Zhengyi and Fan Muhe have been eating various genius treasures planted by Xuanji. Their cultivation has also been rising, and they have reached the half-step of the Mahayana stage. The two of them can already control each other with the highest level of cultivation. Mu Yu, who was a Demon King cultivator, gritted his teeth and said firmly: "Old slave, follow me!" As they were about to go down the mountain and headed towards Jianzong, a group of people suddenly appeared in front of them. "Leave that little boy who knows how to farm and wait for his life, otherwise don't blame us for being ruthless." The leader was an evil cultivator in the Fusion stage, and those behind him actually had three and a half-step Fusion stage, and the other three were in the Void Refining stage. As the lowest-ranking evil cultivator in the team, Mu Yu was the first to stand up and yell at the other side, "Bullshit on you!" Mu Yu didn't dare to do it because they really had a dog in their family, and it was his eldest sister. "It seems that you chose to die early, so we guys can make up for it, and maybe you can go to Mahayana! Hahaha... Let's go together! Don't hurt that little kid who knows how to farm, there's still use in keeping her!" "How dare the unbridled evil cultivator run wild in our Sword Sect's realm!" Along with the voice came a huge sword shadow, heading towards it! Those evil cultivators slashed away. Yes, it was Qin Zhengyi who informed Jianzong.
